title: Song - Au clair de la lune
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: A first song: a familiar tune in the right hand over one block chord per bar in the left (C and G), hands together.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1111-au-clair-de-la-lune: F. Horetzky, "Nº. 21. Au Clair De la Lune." (60 National Airs of Different Nations), classical guitar (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1111)
provenance.note: Melody from Boije collection #268 (http://www.muslib.se/ebibliotek/boije/) (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1111), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
The first eight bars only (the two phrases everyone knows).
